title: Plague-Green Torch
summary: Lit green torch doubles as a light source and simple melee weapon.

fields.Weapon: Simple one-handed, light and dippable, 5-ft melee. 1d4 Bludgeoning plus Strength. When lit, adds 1d4 Fire.
fields.Light: Automatically lights when equipped and stays lit until extinguished. Direct contact can ignite flammable clouds and surfaces.
fields.Acquisition: Chest in the Felogyr’s Fireworks basement.
fields.Base value: 10 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
